title: Law to create an LGBTQ liaison for veterans services
summary: This bill would require the Department of Veterans' Services to designate a staff liaison for LGBTQ veterans, who would conduct outreach, help coordinate discharge upgrade assistance and connect veterans to programs and services. It would also require the department to submit an annual report, starting July 31, 2027, on the number of LGBTQ veterans assisted and related data. The law would take effect immediately if enacted.
